notes: items/19797594, "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (May 2019)": 816 top-level comments (1402131 bytes, the largest thread seen), 4 kept: location-first ("London, UK | TESSIAN"), remote-negated ("Onsite Only", "ONSITE only") and a header where "Remote OK" is followed by "No Visa". UNCLEAR: the Y Combinator terms (https://www.ycombinator.com/legal/, "Site") say "you will not engage in or use any data mining, robots, scraping or similar data gathering or extraction methods", while the HN Search API on Algolia (https://hn.algolia.com/api) is a public, unauthenticated, documented endpoint. Whether that API counts as "the Site" is a question for the owner, which was put to him and is unanswered, so the source stays blocked. robots.txt of news.ycombinator.com sets Crawl-delay: 30 and does not disallow /item; hn.algolia.com serves no robots.txt (404). Employers are NOT given by the API: a comment is free text whose first paragraph is a header, so every observation is tagged employer-unverified. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short text to limit exposure).
